result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. The sidewalk is in poor condition with visible cracking and debris, and the building placement creates a blind corner for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA accessibility
hazards.description: There are no curb ramps at the intersection corner, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner of the two streets in the foreground.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, which fails to designate a clear path for pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway area where the two streets meet.

hazards.name: Poor sidewalk and gutter condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk is cracked and uneven, and there is significant debris and degradation in the gutter area, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk edge and corner in the foreground.

interventions.title: Install ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb transitions at the intersection corner to provide universal access.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or yield signs to manage vehicle speeds and right-of-way at this uncontrolled intersection.

result.summary: This residential intersection features continuous sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corners create high-exposure crossing conditions with potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected space to cross the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The curbs at the corner appear to be standard height without sloped transitions, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in front of the brick row house.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the view between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Parked cars along the curbs on both streets near the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure universal accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way street with a poorly maintained sidewalk adjacent to an industrial-style stone building. The pedestrian environment lacks basic amenities like smooth pavement and clear crossings, though the narrow roadway likely limits vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk consists of uneven, cracked, and shifting concrete slabs, creating significant trip hazards.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A utility pole and trash bags narrow the usable width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant path of travel.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Enhance street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety in this industrial area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a severely degraded sidewalk with significant cracking and overgrowth. There is a complete lack of formal crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps, making the area difficult to navigate for those with mobility challenges.

hazards.name: Severely cracked and uneven sidewalk
hazards.description: The pavement is broken and uneven, creating significant trip hazards and making it inaccessible for wheelchairs or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the image

hazards.name: Overgrown vegetation
hazards.description: Trees and bushes are encroaching on the pedestrian path, narrowing the usable space and potentially obscuring sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to meet ADA standards for accessibility and safety.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly trim trees and bushes to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is usable and sightlines are clear.
